'''2010 Dagobah Regionals Andrew Morris LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Morris]] at [[2010 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
